en: Kilesasaṅkilesikaduka (The Dyad on States Corrupted by Defilements)
Dependent on a state that is neither defilement nor subject to defilement, there arises a state that is neither defilement nor subject to defilement by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is not subject to defilement and is not a defilement, there arises a state that is not subject to defilement and is not a defilement by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor non-defiled and both non-defiled and not a defilement, there arises a state that is neither defiled nor non-defiled by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated.
Nine under root; … pe … nine under non-disappearance.
